title: colubrina elliptica
intro: Colubrina elliptica, commonly known as the Mexican cherry, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing fever and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Colubrina elliptica include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve symptoms associated with respiratory conditions and reduce body temperature in cases of fever. The bioactive constituents of Colubrina elliptica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
